title: Manager, Software Engineering (Dot Net)
description:
We are looking for a **Senior Lead Software Engineer** to join our Technology team at Clarivate and work on the Inprotech product.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced software engineer with strong skills in .NET, Angular, SQL, and enterprise application development. We would love to speak with you if you have a strong technical background, enjoy solving complex problems, and have experience working with large-scale software applications.

**About You: Experience, Education, Skills and Accomplishments**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline, or at least 8 years of equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Minimum 7 years of experience developing web-based or enterprise applications using .NET, C#, SQL, and related technologies.
* Strong understanding of software development principles, including object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean coding practices.
* Strong technical background with experience in server-side frameworks, APIs, system integrations, and event-driven architecture.
* Good experience with SQL Server and relational databases, including writing complex SQL queries, database design, and performance optimization.
* Experience in identifying and troubleshooting application and database performance issues.
* Experience designing and developing scalable, maintainable, and secure enterprise applications.
* Experience with automated testing and CI/CD practices.
* Extensive experience working with version control systems such as Git.

**It would be great, if you also have,**

  

* Experience on frontend technologies like Angular
* Experience working with large, mature enterprise applications and modernization initiatives would be advantageous.

**What Will You Be Doing in This Role?**

  

* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Design, develop, and maintain functionality within Inprotech, working across the application stack.
* Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and well-documented code following engineering best practices.
* Contribute to the design and development of scalable and high-performing solutions.
* Work with SQL Server and relational databases as part of application development, including developing and optimizing queries where required.
* Develop and maintain unit and integration tests as part of an automated Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipeline.
* Participate in technical design and code reviews and provide guidance to other engineers.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across application, integration, and database layers.
* Work closely with QA, Product, Architecture, and other engineering teams to deliver high-quality software.
* Contribute to the modernization and technical improvement of Inprotech, while ensuring stability and compatibility of existing functionality.
* Participate in initiatives to improve engineering processes, product quality, performance, maintainability, and technical debt.
* Mentor and support other developers and promote engineering best practices within the team.
* Stay up to date with relevant technologies and identify opportunities to improve the product and engineering practices.

**About the Team**

The engineering team is geographically distributed, with developers across India and Australia, working closely with Product, QA, Architecture, and other engineering teams across multiple locations.

The team works on a large, mature enterprise application, providing opportunities to work across modern development, complex business functionality, integrations, databases, performance improvements, and application modernization.

**Hours of Work**

This is a permanent position with Clarivate. The standard working day is 9 hours, including the lunch break.

At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

description:

Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

* Experience leading modernization, digital transformation, and AI-enabled engineering initiatives
* Solid experience developing and deploying applications for both iOS and Android platforms
* Practical experience using AI engineering tools such as Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot
* Proven experience designing scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise applications

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js + Spring Boot / Kotlin)
description:
Full Stack Engineer (React.js + Spring Boot / Kotlin)

Key responsibilities

**Frontend**

* Build responsive, accessible web applications using React.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3.

* Create reusable components and manage state with Redux, Context API or React Query.

* Integrate frontend with REST/GraphQL APIs and handle errors, loading states and caching.

* Optimize performance: code splitting, lazy loading, memoization and Core Web Vitals.

**Backend**

* Design and build RESTful APIs and microservices with Spring Boot and Kotlin.

* Model data and write efficient queries for relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) using JPA/Hibernate.

* Implement authentication and authorization with Spring Security, OAuth2 and JWT.

* Integrate with messaging systems (Kafka/RabbitMQ), caches (Redis) and third-party services.

**Engineering practices**

* Apply SOLID principles, clean architecture and design patterns to write maintainable code.

* Write unit, integration and end-to-end tests (JUnit 5, MockK, Jest, React Testing Library).

* Participate across the SDLC: requirement analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and maintenance.

* Work in Agile/Scrum: sprint planning, estimation, stand-ups and retrospectives.

* Review code, give constructive feedback and maintain coding standards.

* Support CI/CD pipelines, monitor production and troubleshoot issues.

Required skills

Frontend- React.js (hooks, functional components), JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, responsive design

State and data - Redux / Context API / React Query; consuming REST APIs

Backend - Spring Boot with Kotlin (Java knowledge is a plus): REST APIs, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security

Databases-SQL (PostgreSQL or MySQL): schema design, indexing, query optimization

Design - Design patterns (Factory, Strategy, Builder, Singleton, Observer, Repository), SOLID, OOP and functional concepts

Architecture - Microservices, layered/clean architecture, API design best practices

SDLC and process - Full SDLC, Agile/Scrum, Jira or similar

Quality- Unit and integration testing (JUnit 5, MockK, Jest), code reviews, clean code

Tooling - Git, GitHub/GitLab, Maven or Gradle, CI/CD basics

We expect at least 2 years of hands-on experience building production web applications, with real ownership on both frontend and backend.

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year

Experience:

* React js: 2 years (Preferred)
* Spring Boot with kotlin: 2 years (Preferred)

description:

=====================================================================

**Experience:** 6–10 Years

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a highly skilled **Senior Full Stack Developer with strong PHP CMS development experience, particularly in Shopify**, along with expertise in modern frontend and backend technologies.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience building, customizing, integrating, and optimizing CMS-based web applications and e-commerce platforms. We are particularly interested in developers who embrace an **AI-first approach to software development**, leveraging AI-powered tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, automate repetitive tasks, and build intelligent application features.

The candidate should be comfortable working across the entire development lifecycle, from architecture and development to deployment, performance optimization, and maintenance.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. PHP & CMS Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using PHP and modern development frameworks.
* Build and customize CMS-based solutions, with a strong preference for Shopify and Shopify Plus.
* Develop custom themes, plugins, modules, and application integrations based on business requirements.
* Work with CMS platforms such as Shopify, WordPress, and other relevant PHP-based platforms.
* Optimize application performance, security, scalability, and maintainability.

### **2. Shopify & E-commerce Development**

* Develop and customize Shopify storefronts, themes, and e-commerce functionalities.
* Work extensively with Shopify Liquid, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frontend frameworks.
* Develop custom Shopify applications and integrate third-party APIs, payment gateways, and external services.
* Work with Shopify APIs, webhooks, and GraphQL/REST APIs for data exchange and application integrations.
* Implement custom checkout experiences and e-commerce workflows where supported by the relevant Shopify plan and APIs.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and improve website performance, user experience, and conversion rates.

### **3. Full Stack Development**

* Develop responsive and high-performance frontend interfaces using JavaScript and modern frontend technologies.
* Build robust backend services, APIs, and integrations using PHP and other relevant backend technologies.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases, including MySQL and other relevant database technologies.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend services, external APIs, and third-party platforms.
* Follow coding standards, implement appropriate testing practices, and participate in code reviews.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver high-quality software solutions.

### **4. AI-First Development Approach**

* Use AI-powered coding assistants and development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and documentation.
* Leverage tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or equivalent AI development platforms.
* Integrate AI APIs and services into web applications wherever they provide meaningful business value.
* Explore AI-driven automation for repetitive development tasks, code refactoring, test generation, and troubleshooting.
* Evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability before implementation.
* Identify opportunities to incorporate AI capabilities into CMS platforms, e-commerce workflows, and customer-facing applications.
* Continuously experiment with emerging AI development practices to improve engineering productivity.

### **5. Deployment & Performance Optimization**

* Work with Git-based version control and collaborative development workflows.
* Deploy and maintain applications in cloud or hosting environments.
* Optimize website speed, responsiveness, SEO fundamentals, and overall application performance.
* Troubleshoot production issues and implement sustainable technical solutions.
* Ensure application security, data integrity, and adherence to development best practices.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

**PHP & CMS**

* 6–10 years of professional software development experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with PHP and CMS-based application development.
* Demonstrable experience developing and customizing Shopify stores and e-commerce solutions.
* Strong understanding of Shopify Liquid, themes, storefront customization, and Shopify APIs.
* Experience with WordPress or other CMS platforms is an advantage.

**Full Stack Technologies**

* Strong proficiency in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web development.
* Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React.js, Vue.js, or equivalent.
* Experience developing REST APIs and integrating third-party services.
* Good understanding of MySQL or other relational databases.
* Familiarity with Node.js or other backend technologies is preferred.

**AI & Development Tools**

* Practical experience using AI-powered development tools in day-to-day engineering.
* Ability to use AI tools for code generation, debugging, refactoring, and test creation.
* Understanding of AI API integrations and the ability to implement AI-enabled application features.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to validate AI-generated code independently.

**Engineering Fundamentals**

* Experience with AI evaluation, guardrails, observability, and runtime monitoring.

About Innovaccer

Innovaccer builds software that helps hospitals, clinics, and health insurance companies make sense of all the scattered data they deal with every day — patient records, appointments, insurance claims, lab results — and turns it into something useful and actionable.

Think of a typical hospital: patient information often lives in a dozen different systems that don't talk to each other well. This causes delays in scheduling, slows down doctors, and makes it harder to catch health problems early. Innovaccer's platform connects all of that data together, and increasingly, uses AI "agents" to actually do some of the manual work for healthcare teams — things like scheduling appointments, preparing insurance paperwork, or drafting clinical notes — so that staff can spend more time with patients and less time on admin work.

Some of the largest healthcare systems in the US — including CommonSpirit Health, Atlantic Health, and Banner Health — use Innovaccer's platform today.

The company is also investing heavily in this direction: in June 2026, Innovaccer signed a multi-year partnership with AWS to run its AI agents at a much larger scale, using AWS's cloud AI tools (Amazon Bedrock) and healthcare-specific data infrastructure (AWS HealthLake). This is a strong signal of where the platform — and this engineering team — is headed next. For more information, visit www.innovaccer.com and check us out on YouTube, Glassdoor, LinkedIn, Instagram, and the Web.

description:
**Frontend / Full Stack Developer**

**Location:** Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, India  
**Work Arrangement:** On\-site  
**Contract:** Full\-time

**About GCRS Group**

GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy supporting businesses across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

Our services include cosmetic safety, regulatory compliance, responsible person services, market access, product stewardship and brand protection across international markets.

We are expanding our technology capabilities and are looking for a **Frontend / Full Stack Developer** to help create modern, responsive and scalable digital products and applications for GCRS.

**The Role**

You will be responsible for developing user\-facing applications while also having the ability to work across the backend where required.

You will work closely with UI/UX designers, backend developers, product stakeholders and business teams to turn concepts and requirements into functional digital products.

The role will involve building new features, improving existing applications, integrating APIs, troubleshooting technical issues and ensuring that our products provide a fast, intuitive and reliable user experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop responsive and user\-friendly web applications
* Build reusable frontend components
* Convert UI/UX designs into functional interfaces
* Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs
* Develop and maintain application features
* Work with backend developers on full\-stack functionality
* Optimize applications for speed and performance
* Ensure compatibility across modern browsers and devices
* Identify and resolve frontend and application issues
* Write clean and maintainable code
* Participate in code reviews and technical discussions
* Implement appropriate testing practices
* Work with designers to ensure accurate implementation of designs
* Collaboration with product and business stakeholders
* Maintain technical documentation where required
* Support deployment and maintenance of applications
* Improve accessibility and usability
* Contribute to frontend development standards
* Identify opportunities for automation and technical improvement

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a developer who combines strong front\-end skills with a broader understanding of full\-stack application development.

You should have a strong eye for detail and care about both technical quality and the user experience.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* Experience in frontend or full\-stack development
* Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Experience with React, Next.js, Vue or a similar modern framework
* Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs
* Understanding of responsive web design
* Knowledge of Git and version Control
* Understanding of browser compatibility and web performance
* Good debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Understanding of basic backend concepts
* Ability to work with databases and APIs
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to understand UI/UX designs and implement them accurately
* Ability to work collaboratively with technical and non\-technical teams

**Desirable Experience**

* TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL and other relational or modern database technologies.

* A background in developing dashboards and data\-intensive applications.
* Experience with automated testing frameworks and AI\-enabled application development

**What Success Will Look Like**

Within your first six months, you will have:

* Delivered high\-quality frontend features
* Improved existing interfaces and application performance
* Worked effectively with the UI/UX and backend teams
* Contributed to scalable frontend architecture
* Reduced recurring technical issues
* Improved the consistency and usability of our digital products
* Delivered projects within agreed timelines
* Contributed to a stronger development workflow

You will join a growing international organisation where technology is becoming an increasingly important part of our services and operations. You will have the opportunity to work on new products rather than simply maintaining legacy systems, with scope to grow into a senior developer, full\-stack or technical leadership role.

**Important:** This is a **fully on\-site role based at the GCRS office in Hapur, Uttar Pradesh**. Candidates must be willing to **work from the Hapur office five days a week**.
